title: eludite.navigation.go_to_* output
description: What the Go To command did. From the UI thread this is the state right after the request was sent, usually `loading`; from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the answer.

path.description: The document the request was made in.

line.description: 1-based line the request was made at.

column.description: 1-based column the request was made at.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server; `navigated`: the target is open with the caret on it; `choose`: several targets, the picker is open (choose with `target`); `none`: nothing found; `failed`: the request failed (no language server, the server does not offer it, or an error).

targets.description: The targets found, in the language server's order (at most 100).

path.description: Absolute path of the file (or the `roslyn-source-generated://` URI of a source-generated document).

metadata.description: True when the target is the language server's metadata-as-source (decompiled) text; it opens read-only.

generated.description: True when the target is a source-generated document (its text comes from the language server); it opens read-only.

title.description: The tab title the target opens with (`Foo.cs`, `Foo [from metadata]`, `Foo.g.cs [generated]`).

path.description: Absolute path of the file (or the `roslyn-source-generated://` URI of a source-generated document).
